sentences.en: Our story comes from Jesuit priest Jim Martin.
sentences.zh: 我们的故事来自耶稣会神父吉姆·马丁（Jim Martin）。

sentences.en: In 2000, Jim's father was diagnosed with lung cancer.
sentences.zh: 2000年，吉姆的父亲被诊断出患有肺癌。

sentences.en: One of the people he will never forget from that time was a nun named Janice Farnham.
sentences.zh: 在那段时期，他永远不会忘记的人之一是一位名叫珍妮丝·法纳姆（Janice Farnham）的修女。

sentences.en: Janice was one of Jim's professors in theology school and had become a family friend.
sentences.zh: 珍妮丝曾是吉姆在神学院的教授，后来成了他们家的朋友。

sentences.en: She had a special fondness for Jim's father.
sentences.zh: 她对吉姆的父亲有着特殊的感情。

sentences.en: And right before he died, Janice said to me, well, I'd like to come visit him.
sentences.zh: 就在他去世前，珍妮丝对我说：“我想去看看他。”

sentences.en: And now she lived in Boston and, you know, she's on a Catholic sister's budget, right?
sentences.zh: 她当时住在波士顿，你知道，修女的生活预算很有限，对吧？

sentences.en: They take a vow of poverty.
sentences.zh: 她们发过贫穷誓愿。

sentences.en: And Janice got on a train, took the train down five hours to Philadelphia, took another
sentences.zh: 珍妮丝坐上火车，花了五个小时来到费城，又换乘了

sentences.en: commuter train, found her way to the hospital, spent time with my dad, got back on the train
sentences.zh: 通勤火车，找到了医院，陪我父亲待了一会儿，然后又坐上火车

sentences.en: and went back home.
sentences.zh: 回家了。

sentences.en: And I thought it was one of the nicest things that anyone has ever done for me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是别人为我做过的最贴心的事情之一。

sentences.en: And I said, you know, I can't believe you did.
sentences.zh: 我说：“你知道吗，真不敢相信你竟然这么做了。”

sentences.en: And she said, of course, you know, why wouldn't I want to come down and see your dad?
sentences.zh: 她说：“当然了，我怎么会不想来看看你父亲呢？”

sentences.en: So this just really gracious, generous gesture of love and the fact that a Catholic sister would come down and visit my dad was a big deal for him.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常优雅、慷慨的爱之举，而且一位天主教修女能来看望我父亲，对他来说意义重大。

sentences.en: It's very moving.
sentences.zh: 这非常感人。

sentences.en: And I think it prepared him for, you know, his his death.
sentences.zh: 我认为这让他为自己的离世做好了准备。

sentences.en: He died, I think, a week or two later.
sentences.zh: 我想他大概在一两周后就去世了。

sentences.en: So I think it's a reminder that, you know, someone said 99 percent of life is showing up.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这提醒了我们，有人说过，生活99%在于“在场”，

sentences.en: and that these gestures that we make really stick with people.
sentences.zh: 而我们所做的这些举动真的会留在人们心中。

sentences.en: You know, one of my rules now in life is,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我现在的人生准则之一就是：

sentences.en: when it comes to funerals or weddings or baptisms
sentences.zh: 无论是葬礼、婚礼还是洗礼，

sentences.en: or certainly visiting people in the hospital or anything like that,
sentences.zh: 或者去医院探望病人等等，

sentences.en: if I can go, I will go.
sentences.zh: 只要我能去，我就一定会去。

sentences.en: If I'm able to go, if I'm there, I will go.
sentences.zh: 如果我能去，如果我在那里，我就会去。

sentences.en: And never underestimate that,
sentences.zh: 永远不要低估这一点，

sentences.en: what we call in the Jesuits, ministry of presence, just showing up.
sentences.zh: 也就是我们在耶稣会中所说的“在场的侍奉”，仅仅是出现在那里。
